text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru put up a tremendous 
fight on the stage of the Kikuka Sho as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She happily explains that her success was 
because the power of God had turned her 
into the "embodiment of happiness."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her feverish eyes are clearly abnormal. 
Worried, her Trainer decided to space out 
her races and set their sights on next 
spring's Kinko Sho.
